description: This file defines a set of functions implementing an indented JSON serialization mechanism within a CMake build system context. It provides callback functions for serializing JSON objects, arrays, key-value pairs, and literals with indentation control, and sets up a callback table for JSON serialization.

methods.name: json_indented
methods.description: Main function that initializes the JSON indentation context, sets up callback functions for JSON serialization, and executes serialization with indentation.
